title: rhododendron minus var. majus
intro: Rhododendron minus var. majus, commonly known as the high-altitude rhododendron, is a variety of the rhododendron plant, known for its medicinal properties. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron minus var. majus include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in relieving cough and cold symptoms. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
